comparison.role: Advanced Player's Guide Alchemist ~ Poison Resistance row: DESC "You gain a +%1 bonus on all saving throws against poison.", AlchemistPoisonResistanceBonus +2 at AlchemistLVL 2, 5 and 8; SOURCEPAGE p.31.

lines.text: Poison Resistance (Ex): At 2nd level, an alchemist gains a +2 bonus on all saving throws against poison. This bonus increases to +4 at 5th level, and then again to +6 at 8th level. At 10th level, an alchemist becomes completely immune to poison.

prdComparison.role: Poison Resistance (Advanced Player's Guide, alchemist): the body's second sentence is identical; its first reads "the character" for "an alchemist"; the body leaves out the 10th-level immunity, the Alchemist's Poison Immunity feature.

lines.text: Poison Resistance (Ex): At 2nd level, an investigator gains a +2 bonus on all saving throws against poison. This bonus increases to +4 at 5th level and to +6 at 8th level. At 11th level, the investigator gains immunity to poison.

additionalPrdComparisons.role: Poison Resistance (Advanced Class Guide, investigator): the same bonuses (+2, +4 at 5th, +6 at 8th); the 11th-level immunity is the Investigator's own feature.

grantEvidence.role: Granted at Alchemist level 2, Investigator level 2: Foundry classAssociations; PCGen apg_abilities_globalvar.lst:30, acg_classes.lst:187. The reviewed schedule gives the later rows as increments.

#606 (curation #619 wave E (increment parents, contextNotes)) required note checked against the complete pinned body at https://gitlab.com/foundryvtt_pathfinder1e/foundryvtt-pathfinder1/-/blob/418761d2e16a6037c0156bb4a241f7cea5a2986d/packs/class-abilities/poison-resistance.2qcz39w9O2Qlms0Q.yaml. The +2 to +6 bonus on all saving throws against poison. Foundry's @class.level is the granting class's level, @classLevel.<tag> (docs/character-sheet/modifiers.md). The body is granted by the Alchemist and the Investigator, each at 2nd level, and nothing makes the two classes' bonuses stack (Trap Sense says so; this body does not, and PCGen keeps two separate bonuses, AlchemistPoisonResistanceBonus and InvestigatorPoisonResistanceBonus, apg_abilities_class.lst:95, acg_abilities_class.lst:1247), so the higher of the two class levels counts: min(6, floor((max(@classLevel.alchemist, @classLevel.investigator) + 1) / 3) * 2). +2 at 2nd, +4 at 5th, +6 at 8th (body; PRD advancedPlayersGuide/baseClasses/alchemist.html:429 and advancedClassGuide/classes/investigator.html:428), as the reviewed schedule; the immunity at 10th (Alchemist) and 11th (Investigator) is the separate Poison Immunity feature (pf1/tflIOhX6ukxtwXLx), outside this body. allSavingThrows is saves (docs/character-sheet/modifiers.md). Untyped. The note's "vs poison" is the shared Situation poison ("vs. poison"), as Bravery's "vs fear effects" is fear. Class levels are structural inputs, readable by saves. No separate Note: the Modifier states the whole rule.

classFeatureReview.scheduleRule: Poison resistance bonus by class level = min(6, floor((level + 1) / 3) * 2) from 2nd: +2 at 2nd, +4 at 5th, +6 at 8th, for each granting class (PRD alchemist.html:429 and Table: Alchemist :357-376; investigator.html:428 and Table: Investigator :378-397); PCGen's +2 steps at levels 2, 5 and 8 (apg_abilities_class.lst:95; acg_abilities_class.lst:1255-1257) agree.
